newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate surges to 6-month high.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate surges to 6-month high.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate soared to a six-month high late on Wednesday on severely tight liquidity in the money market on the eve of the Lunar New Year and bank reserve requirement due on Friday, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate was quoted at 17.50-18.00 percent in late trade, its highest level since end-July 1996 when it stood at 25.00-26.00 percent, dealers said. more an va
"There were almost no lenders in the market today. Liquidity will remain tight through the Lunar New Year and after bank reserve requirement by Friday," a dealer at a foreign bank said.
Heavy dollar buying in the morning also further squeezed money supply, dealers said.
The baht rallied to 25.927/25.933 to the dollar late from 25.930/25.935 in the early morning as high interbank rates prompted late dollar selling for the baht, dealers said.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the baht/dollar mid-rate at 25.89 against 25.86 on Tuesday.
"There was very heavy dollar selling in late afternoon. Liquidity was very tight and demand for baht was very strong," one money dealer said.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium rose to 15.50/16.50 satangs per dollar late from 13.00/13.50 in the morning.
